To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the social media has a strong influence on the purchase decision of the consumers.
the attitude of consumers towards the purchase of cars is significantly affected by the social media information search.
the attitude of male and female consumers towards car factors (economicals, functionals and psychologicals) is different from each other in terms of their information search through social media.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the impact of social media on the purchase intension of automobile giving special focus on cars.
the transformation of consumer attitude through social media towards purchase intention of cars.
the impact of consumer attitude and purchase intentions towards social media marketing in automobile industry.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is a meaningful relationship among the car related factors, income, family type and social media information search.
social media is a powerful tool to influence consumer's attitude towards the purchase intension of a car.
the study provides a clear picture of the consumer attitude towards purchase intension of car.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
social media is an effective tool for marketing and it has a significant influence on consumer's attitude.
social media has a significant impact on consumer's purchase intention of cars.
there is a significant difference between males and females in terms of their attitude towards car purchase intension.
The main takeaway from our work is that
marketers should focus on the car factors (economically, functionally and psychologically) and their relationship with income and family types.
social media has a significant role to play in shaping consumer's attitude and hence the purchase intention of automobiles.
social media can play a vital role in transforming consumer's attitude and hence can be a great platform for marketing of automobiles.
